// note: One entry per crew member. `id` is what the machine uses; `displayName` is what people type after @.
Workspace ownership is enforced, not just documented: an agent may only be assigned work whose
`repo` appears in its `repos` list. See docs/OWNERSHIP.md for why.

agents.// canMerge: Exactly one agent should have this. It is the single merge gate.

agents.// transport: remote = runs on another machine via the WebSocket bridge (bin/mousecrew-worker.js).
agents.// selfManaged: Skips the audit lane: submitted -> accepted by a human, never auditing.

agents.// transport: terminal = an interactive TUI you also use. Needs the terminal adapter (batch 2).

agents.// runner:exec: Generic adapter — any CLI that reads a prompt on stdin and prints a reply.
